run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T02:35:19Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is firing because the frontend's /api/data request path lost its ad backend. In the 19-minute span ending 02:47:00Z the frontend's only error spans (497.12 each) are GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds; every other frontend operation had a zero error-span increase, and frontend-proxy's ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans began erroring in the same samples. Error increases were 0 up to the 02:35:00Z sample and nonzero from the 02:37:00Z sample. The ad workload has no pod at all: the ad Deployment wants 1 replica but reports readyReplicas/availableReplicas null with Available=False (MinimumReplicasUnavailable) and ReplicaFailure FailedCreate, the Service 'ad' endpoint object has no subsets, and ad span production stopped after the 02:36:00Z sample. Events show the ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w killed at 02:34:17Z (Deployment ad scaled its ReplicaSet 1->0, then 0->1 at 02:34:27Z) and 17 ReplicaSet FailedCreate events from 02:34:27Z to 02:39:55Z whose message is exact: 'pods "ad-554b849958-..." is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'. ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo was created at 02:34:07Z (10 s before the pod kill) with hard memory 1503238553600m (~1433Mi) while the 19 remaining otel-demo pods already request 1901Mi, so no replacement ad pod can be admitted. Namely the ad pod replacement being forbidden by that quota is what leaves the ad Service without endpoints and keeps the frontend /api/data calls failing. What actually scaled the ad Deployment to 0, and who created the quota, is not observable here (no change history).

claims.text: In the 19-minute span ending 02:47:00Z the frontend's STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases were exactly 497.1202193548387 each on span_name 'GET /api/data', 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', while GET, POST, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, /api/checkout, /api/products/[productId], /api/recommendations, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations had a 0 error-span increase.

Same 19-minute window, per service: STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases were frontend 2005.9778623655914, frontend-proxy 1017.9128301075268, fraud-detection 2.058468817204301, ad 1.0292344086021505 and recommendation 1.0292344086021505, and 0 for accounting, cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, payment, product-catalog, quote and shipping.

Time course (2-minute increase samples 02:27:00Z-02:45:00Z): frontend GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error increases were 0 at 02:27, 02:29, 02:31, 02:33 and 02:35, then 70.66666666666666 at 02:37, 83.7984 at 02:39, 69.33333333333333 at 02:41 and 64 at 02:43. frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error increases became nonzero in the same samples (74.66666666666666 at 02:37 through 62.666666666666664 at 02:43), and frontend span_name 'tcp.connect' showed a 2.6666666666666665 error increase only at the 02:37 sample.

The newest traces Jaeger returned for service ad (queried 02:30:00Z-02:47:00Z) are from 02:33:29.753642Z-02:33:35.588853Z and show success: ad spans 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' with rpc.grpc.status_code "0", frontend 'GET /api/data' with http.status_code "200". In those traces the frontend client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds is a child of the frontend span 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', which is a child of the frontend span 'GET /api/data'.

Service ad stopped producing spans: 2-minute increases of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="ad"} were 155.99-206.67 per sample from 02:28 to 02:34, 72 at the 02:36:00Z sample, and 0 at every sample from 02:38:00Z through 02:44:00Z.

No ad pod exists: the namespace otel-demo pod list returned 20 pods (accounting, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) and none of them is an ad pod, and a cluster-wide pod query for names matching the ad pattern returned only pod load-generator-57ffcd644-rwl8b.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has spec.replicas 1 but status.readyReplicas null and status.availableReplicas null; its conditions are Available=False reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable message 'Deployment does not have minimum availability.' and ReplicaFailure=True reason FailedCreate message 'pods "ad-554b849958-v9dqt" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'. Its container image is ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with requests memory 225Mi and limits memory 450Mi, and its revision annotation is '1'. Among all otel-demo Deployments returned, ad is the only one with null ready and available replicas.
ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (owner Deployment ad, created 02:03:50Z) has spec.replicas 1, readyReplicas null, availableReplicas null and condition ReplicaFailure=True with reason FailedCreate.
The Service endpoint object 'ad' in namespace otel-demo has subsets null, i.e. no ready addresses for the ad service.

Events on ad objects: Deployment ad 'Scaled down replica set ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0' and pod ad-554b849958-p226w kubelet event reason Killing message 'Stopping container ad' and ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 SuccessfulDelete 'Deleted pod: ad-554b849958-p226w', all at 02:34:17Z; Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-554b849958 from 0 to 1' at 02:34:27Z; then 17 ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 FailedCreate (Warning) events between 02:34:27Z and 02:39:55Z with message 'Error creating: pods "ad-554b849958-<suffix>" is forbidden: exceeded quota: otel-demo-memory, requested: memory=225Mi, used: memory=1901Mi, limited: memory=1503238553600m'.
ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory in namespace otel-demo was created at 2026-11-18T02:34:07Z, has spec.hard memory 1503238553600m, and reports status.used memory 1901Mi against that hard value.

The memory requests of the 19 running otel-demo pods sum to exactly 1901Mi (e.g. kafka 300Mi, flagd containers 120Mi and 250Mi, fraud-detection 200Mi, accounting 160Mi, otel-collector 150Mi, checkout 128Mi, load-generator 100Mi, frontend 100Mi), which equals the ResourceQuota's used memory; no ad container is included in that sum.

ConfigMap flagd-config in namespace otel-demo holds demo.flagd.json in which every fault-injection flag is in its off variant: adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure have defaultVariant "off"; paymentFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, emailMemoryLeak and imageSlowLoad also have defaultVariant "off".

Pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 is Running with its container ready and restartCount 0, and the frontend's error spans are confined to the /api/data -> 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' -> grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds path while its cart, checkout, recommendations and product routes show 0 error-span increase; this argues against a fault inside the frontend application itself.
The flagd feature-flag fault injections (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc and the other flags) did not cause the ad failures: the flagd-config ConfigMap shows every flag's defaultVariant as "off".

Because ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory's hard memory (1503238553600m, about 1433Mi) is below the namespace's already-admitted memory requests (1901Mi), every replacement pod in otel-demo is rejected; the ad Deployment therefore cannot regain a pod (requested 225Mi) and the frontend's /api/data -> AdService/GetAds calls keep failing until that quota is raised/removed or requests are lowered.

The timing suggests a deliberate change pair: ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory was created at 02:34:07Z, pod ad-554b849958-p226w was killed with Deployment ad scaled 1->0 at 02:34:17Z, and the scale-up at 02:34:27Z was immediately rejected by the quota; the actor behind either change is not visible in the collected evidence.

Raise or remove the otel-demo-memory hard memory limit (or lower pod memory requests) so at least the ad pod's 225Mi request fits, then verify that a new ad pod becomes Ready and that the 'ad' endpoint object regains addresses.

Consult the cluster audit log or change history for the creation of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 02:34:07Z and for the scale of Deployment ad to 0 at 02:34:17Z, since change_history is not integrated in this Run.

Add alerting on ResourceQuota used-versus-hard memory and on Deployments with zero available replicas in otel-demo, so a workload that loses its last pod to a quota shows up directly instead of only as frontend request errors.

gaps: Who created ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory at 02:34:07Z and who scaled Deployment ad from 1 to 0 at 02:34:17Z is unknown; the change_history integration is not available in this Run, and no auditor/actor field appears in the collected events.

The exact error returned on the failing frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and GET /api/data spans is unknown: traces_search_by_tags on frontend with tags error=true, http.status_code="500" and rpc.grpc.status_code="14" each returned no spans for 02:30-02:51, and traces_search for frontend in 02:36-02:45 returned no traces; the newest traces returned were 02:33:29-02:33:35 and were successful.
Frontend application logs are unavailable: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-nkn95 (both unfiltered and filtered on error/warn terms) returned 0 lines and 0 bytes read for 02:30-02:51.

Logs and last termination state of the deleted ad pod ad-554b849958-p226w cannot be read (the pod no longer exists); apart from the kubelet Killing event with message 'Stopping container ad' at 02:34:17Z, no OOMKilled or crash evidence was observed for it.

Kube-state-metrics deployment series could not be used: kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace="otel-demo",deployment="ad"} and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="otel-demo"} returned no series in 02:20-02:51, and get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_deployment.*"} returned nothing, so ad readiness could not be charted as a time series.
Whether the ResourceQuota's hard value was modified after its 02:34:07Z creation cannot be verified; it already sat below the namespace's 1901Mi of existing requests at creation time.

Whether frontend error spans continued after the last available samples (02:45:00Z-02:47:00Z) is unknown; the metric source data ended around then and the ad Deployment was still at zero available replicas at query time.
No audit of other namespaces' quota changes during the window was possible; only otel-demo had a ResourceQuota object, but change history for it is not integrated.

All otel-demo pods have startTime 02:03:50Z-02:05:44Z (about 30 minutes before the alert) and flagd pods 02:05:44Z; the cause of that namespace-wide (re)start is not observable and no evidence ties it to this incident.
next_steps: Review cluster audit logs for creation of ResourceQuota otel-demo-memory (02:34:07Z) and the ad Deployment scale-to-zero (02:34:17Z).
Right-size the otel-demo-memory hard limit or the pod memory requests so the namespace fits with headroom for the ad pod, then confirm the ad pod becomes Ready and the 'ad' endpoints repopulate.
Confirm in the frontend server logs the exact gRPC status returned for AdService/GetAds while the ad pod is absent, which the sampled traces did not capture.
Verify the ResourceQuota's desired value with the team that owns otel-demo before changing it, since the quota was created inside the incident window and its origin is unexplained.

view.span_groups_note: span_groups summarizes the spans shown in content; spans the adapter sampled out are not counted in any group.
view.incomplete_reason: backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist

view.series_note: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation of the service (internal, client and server spans alike), summed over the labels kept in this query; it is not a count of requests. status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status; it does not mean the call succeeded.

traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation of the service (internal, client and server spans alike), summed over the labels kept in this query; it is not a count of requests. status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET means the span carried no status; it does not mean the call succeeded.

query.jq_expr: .items[] | {name: .metadata.name, phase: .status.phase, ready: [.status.containerStatuses[]? | {n: .name, ready: .ready, restarts: .restartCount, lastTerm: .lastState.terminated.reason, lastExit: .lastState.terminated.exitCode}], startTime: .status.startTime, owner: (.metadata.ownerReferences[0] // {})}

view.cannot_prove: Objects are the cluster's state when the query ran, not during the incident window: they cannot prove what was true earlier, and an object missing now may have existed then. Events cover only their own timestamps inside the window; an event that is not returned is unknown, not proof nothing happened (events expire and timestamps are often null). A jq result is what the expression selected, not a full picture of the kind.

      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    endpoint: http://prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8889
extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  resourcedetection:
    detectors:
    - env
    - system
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  nginx:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: http://image-provider:8081/status
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  postgresql:
    endpoint: postgresql:5432
    metrics:
      postgresql.blks_hit:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.blks_read:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.deadlocks:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_deleted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_fetched:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_inserted:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_returned:
        enabled: true
      postgresql.tup_updated:
        enabled: true
    password: [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
    tls:
      insecure: true
    username: root
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
    username: valkey
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - debug
      - prometheus
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - nginx
      - otlp
      - postgresql
      - redis
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - clickhouse
      - debug
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resourcedetection
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - pull:
          exporter:
            prometheus:
              host: 0.0.0.0
              port: 8888
